description: Lists users from mite, active ones or with `archived: true` the archived ones; use it to look up user ids for `user_id` in `mite_list_time_entries`, and `mite_whoami` for the current user. Returns id, name, role and archived flag per user; email addresses and hourly rates are not returned. The whole list is returned at once without paging.

archived.description: true = list archived entries instead of the active ones, e.g. true. Default: false.

name: mite_list_users
title: List users
